name: VramCopyStream
comment: HL = VRAM destination; DE = stream of count/rows/tiles (count bit 7 = repeat one tile); copies the rows (shared by VramCopyRows)

name: AddOamSprite
comment: appends one OAM entry from hScratch values to the shadow at $c000 (hOamCount wraps at 39)

name: MoveObject
comment: applies the object's direction (+$10) and speed (+$11) from D_00_0bb6 to its position with MultiplyByDE

name: ClampObjectToRoom
comment: keeps the object inside the room limits after MoveObject (offsets $06 and $0c)

name: CounterToFrame
comment: turns a running counter and a bit mask (hScratch06-08) into a frame index

name: DigitToTile
comment: A = BCD digit; returns the digit tile id from D_00_1d2f

name: InitBonusCursor
comment: resets the door selection cursor (wCursorIndex 0; cursor object at $80/$50)

name: EndingTick
comment: one step of the ending scene: hero movement then the object animation

name: EndingMoveHero
comment: moves the hero in the ending scene until it reaches $c775 = $50

name: EndingHeroFrame
comment: chooses the hero frame and flips it by $c782 bit 0

name: EndingAnimateObject
comment: cycles the ending object between the frame tables D_00_30df and D_00_3111

name: EndingWalkStep
comment: steps the walking animation counters at $c77e-$c780

name: EndingCastleBlink
comment: toggles the castle flag animation from D_00_3148

name: EndingAdvance
comment: advances $c781/$c782 by $10 per call; sets $c7ae bit 7 at 5

name: EnemyScreenPosition
comment: converts enemy pixel position to screen coordinates (camera subtracted) in hScratch00/01

name: RemoveEnemy
comment: clears the active bit of hObject2 and decrements wEnemyCount

name: RememberEnemyPosition
comment: stores hEnemyX/hEnemyY at $c525/$c526

name: MoveAndClampObject
comment: MoveObject then ClampObjectToRoom

name: EnemyTileUnder
